PyP6 5.1 makes it easy to check which sample is on a pad before moving it. Compared with 5.0.0:

## Click to play in Drag mode
In the all-banks views, **clicking a pad in Drag mode now plays it**, and clicking it again stops it. You can hear what a pad holds right before dragging it, without switching Drag mode off. Dragging still moves the pad and never plays anything, and clicking an empty pad still just selects it.

In the **All banks + patterns** view the highlighting works in Drag mode too: playing a pad lights the patterns that play it, and selecting a pattern lights its pads.

## Downloads

| Download | For |
|---|---|
| `PyP6-v5.1.0-windows-x64.zip` | Windows 10/11, 64-bit |
| `PyP6-v5.1.0-macos-arm64.zip` | Macs with Apple Silicon (M1 and later) |
| `PyP6-v5.1.0-macos-x64.zip` | Intel Macs |
| `PyP6-v5.1.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` | 64-bit Linux |

**First launch:**
- **Windows:** SmartScreen may warn about an unsigned app. Choose "Run anyway".
- **macOS:** the app is not signed with an Apple certificate. Right-click it, choose **Open**, then **Open** again (on macOS 15 and later, allow it under System Settings → Privacy & Security).
- **Linux:** audio playback needs PortAudio from your distribution, e.g. `sudo apt install libportaudio2`.

## Upgrading
Nothing changes in presets or pattern files: everything saved by 5.0 loads in 5.1 as before.
